finding: One abstract zombie base; 75 children inherit it and override only name, text, colour, one stat band or one special attack. 814 of 1172 concrete monsters use copy-from.
Tier-up is a weighted pick from a named monstergroup pool (GROUP_ZOMBIE_UPGRADE, 23 members) with a half_life timer; we would decide the tier at spawn on the server instead.
Size tiers are a proportional multiplier block (128 entries) on a base, e.g. a small form at half hp and faster speed; 129 entries borrow a sprite with looks_like.
Naming grammar: 56 of 75 zombie-base children keep the family noun; others use a modifier word plus a tier word. Half read: data pack only; engine spot-checked at two lines.
56 monster base templates hold 624 monsters; 49 bases have 5 or more members. Each monster names its base for glyph, pain set and default flags.

Colour is the element inside one body: the six-colour dragon base gives one element per colour at the same depth and hp; a four-member insect base swaps one bite or breath per member with a small speed step.

Bosses are 101 UNIQUE entries across 33 bases; 32 of those bases also have ordinary members. Unique hp median 2500 against 118.5; depth median 50 against 26. So a boss is a bigger form of the family base.

Nine top-tier dragons use a multi-step colour cycle (color-cycle), the only animated monsters in the data; blow_methods gives an attack verb per blow method (19 entries). Half read: data pack; engine located only.
